image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming in dark water. The fish displays characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes. Its dorsal fin spines are elongated and fanned out, showing distinct banding. The pectoral fins are large, fan-like, and translucent with rays visible. The head is prominent with a visible eye and mouth structure. There is a faint watermark or text artifact in the bottom left corner.
